def _parse_ruby_link(inline: 'InlineParser', state: 'InlineState', pos: int,
    tokens: List[Dict[str, Any]]) ->Optional[int]:
    src = state.src
    if pos >= len(src):
        return None
    if src[pos] != '[':
        return None
    
    # Try to parse a link after the ruby text
    link_pos = parse_link(inline, state, pos, tokens)
    if link_pos:
        # If link found, append all ruby tokens and return link position
        for token in tokens:
            state.append_token(token)
        return link_pos

    label_pos = parse_link_label(inline, state, pos, tokens)
    if label_pos:
        # If link label found, append all ruby tokens and return label position
        for token in tokens:
            state.append_token(token)
        return label_pos
        
    # No link or link label found, append tokens and return None
    for token in tokens:
        state.append_token(token)
    return None
